{{ $indicator := .JSON.String "status.indicator" }}

<style>
  .logo-github-status-components img {
    height: 24px;
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .logo-github-status-components .logo-white-github-status-components {
    display: block;
  }
  .logo-github-status-components .logo-black-github-status-components {
    display: none;
  }
  :root[data-scheme="light"] .logo-github-status-components .logo-white-github-status-components {
    display: none;
  }
  :root[data-scheme="light"] .logo-github-status-components .logo-black-github-status-components {
    display: block;
  }
</style>

<div>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-15 margin-bottom-15">
    <div class="grow min-width-0">
      <a class="logo-github-status-components" href="https://www.githubstatus.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label="GitHub Status" style="display: block; width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 5px;">
        <img class="logo-white-github-status-components" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" aria-hidden="true">
        <img class="logo-black-github-status-components" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" aria-hidden="true">
      </a>
      <ul class="list-horizontal-text">
        {{ if eq $indicator "none" }}<li class="color-positive">All Systems Operational</li>
        {{ else if eq $indicator "minor" }}<li class="color-highlight">Minor Issues</li>
        {{ else if eq $indicator "major" }}<li class="color-negative">Major Outage</li>
        {{ else if eq $indicator "critical" }}<li class="color-negative">Critical Issues</li>
        {{ else }}<li>{{ .JSON.String "status.description" }}</li>{{ end }}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>

  <ul class="list list-gap-8">
    {{ range .JSON.Array "components" }}
      {{ $status := .String "status" }}
      {{ $hiddenWhenHealthy := and (.Bool "only_show_if_degraded") (eq $status "operational") }}
      {{ if and (not (.Bool "group")) (not $hiddenWhenHealthy) (ne (.String "description") "") }}
        <li class="flex items-center gap-10">
          <span style="width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto;
            {{ if eq $status "operational" }}background-color: var(--color-positive);
            {{ else if eq $status "degraded_performance" }}background-color: var(--color-highlight);
            {{ else if eq $status "under_maintenance" }}background-color: var(--color-text-subdue);
            {{ else }}background-color: var(--color-negative);{{ end }}"></span>
          <span class="size-h6">{{ .String "name" }}</span>
          <span class="size-h6 color-subdue" style="margin-left: auto;">
            {{ if eq $status "operational" }}OK
            {{ else if eq $status "degraded_performance" }}Degraded
            {{ else if eq $status "partial_outage" }}Partial Outage
            {{ else if eq $status "major_outage" }}Major Outage
            {{ else if eq $status "under_maintenance" }}Maintenance
            {{ else }}{{ $status }}{{ end }}
          </span>
        </li>
      {{ end }}
    {{ end }}
  </ul>
</div>

required: |
  url: https://www.githubstatus.com/api/v2/summary.json
